plain.li: Got shown round by someone with a limp who talked the whole way. I remember where the food is. That's about it.
[night] Can't sleep. Every noise outside sounds like it has too many legs. The others snore through all of it.
[summer,hot] Got here burnt red across the back of my neck. The water they gave me was warm, and I drank every drop.
[child] A grown-up here gave me a blanket and didn't ask me any questions. I'm keeping the blanket.
[old] Too old to be starting over. My knees ached the whole road here and they ache now.

warm.li: Someone saved me the last warm bowl and wouldn't hear a word about it. I'll learn their name tomorrow and thank them properly.
[skill:Cooking] I offered to cook tomorrow. The looks on their faces told me exactly how long they've been eating the same thing.

blunt.li: No one's tried to rob me yet. That's more than I can say for the last place.
[large] Too many faces. I'll learn the useful ones' names first.

cheerful.li: I have my own bed! There's a beetle living under it, but we've come to an understanding.
[spring] Mud to my knees and green shoots everywhere. I'm taking that as a good sign!

gloomy.li: They seem decent. The last lot seemed decent too, right up until they didn't.
[rain,night] Rain on a roof that isn't mine. I keep waiting for someone to tell me to leave.

cold.li: Two of them are competent. One is a liability. The rest I haven't measured yet.
[poor] Thin stores, weak walls. They need me more than I need them. A useful position to start from.

plain.li: Found some blank pages, so here's a journal. The roof over my bed leaks.
[child] This is my journal. If you are not me, stop reading. That means you.
[teen] The adults keep talking about where they came from like it's a real place. This journal is only for things that actually happen here.
[lowtech] Writing in charcoal on a scraped hide. It smudges if I so much as breathe on it.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] Started a journal because it's the only hobby that can be done lying down.

warm.li: Something to leave for whoever comes after. Proof we were here, and tried, and some days it went well.
[large] So many people here now. I'm writing down one good thing about each of them before I forget who did what.

blunt.li: First entry. Things I hate so far: the cold, the food, two of the people. Won't say which.
[doubtful] Starting this so there's a record of what the council says it'll do. Someone has to keep track.

cheerful.li: Page one! I drew the colony at the top, and made the walls a bit taller than they are.
[highmood] Good day. Good enough that I wanted it kept somewhere, so I started this!

gloomy.li: Started a journal. I doubt I'll fill it.
[storm] Thunder rattling the walls all night. Seemed like the right time to start writing things down, in case the roof goes.

cold.li: I'll record what each of them contributes. It will be useful when the time comes to decide who is necessary.
[spacer] Log started on a salvaged datapad. The previous owner had poor security and worse poetry. Both deleted.

plain.li: It's done: {WISH}. Caught myself smiling at a fence post on the way to supper.
[repeat] Second time asking, and this time it stuck. Maybe I just needed to be more annoying.
[forother] I never even asked for this. Someone spoke up for me, and the council listened. I should find out who.
[child] The grown-ups said yes! I said thank you to every one of them, twice.
[poor] We have almost nothing, and they still found a way. I feel guilty about it.

warm.li: I said thank you four times before someone told me to stop. So here's a fifth.
[trusting] They keep doing right by me. I mean to deserve it.

blunt.li: Didn't even have to shout this time. Progress.
[trait:Greedy] Got it. Already thinking about what to ask for next.

cheerful.li: A yes! I did a dance in the storeroom and the cook walked in on it.
[cold] Frost on the inside of the shutters, and I don't care one bit. They said yes!

gloomy.li: They gave me what I wanted. Now I have something to lose.
[lowmood] Even this didn't lift me much. It isn't their fault. They tried.

cold.li: They granted "{WISH}". Now I know roughly what my goodwill costs them.
[rich] They could afford it easily. I should have asked for more.

plain.li: They promised me "{WISH}" and here it is. I'd had a whole speech ready for when they forgot.
[doubtful] I'd half written the angry entry already. I've crossed it out.
[bitter] One kept promise doesn't make up for the rest. It's more than I expected, though.
[old] I'm old enough to know how rarely promises get kept. This one was.
[teen] They actually did what they said they would. I didn't think adults did that.

warm.li: A promise kept: {WISH}. I made sure to thank the ones who did the actual work, not just the ones who gave their word.
[winter] Bitter cold out, and they still kept their word. I'll bring that up the next time someone grumbles about the council.

blunt.li: They kept their word. Don't tell them I was surprised.
[hurt] Can barely stand, but they kept their word. That did more for me than the medicine, and the medicine tastes like boot.

cheerful.li: They promised and they did it! I'm going to bring it up at every meal for a week.
Promise kept, full belly. If tomorrow's half this good I'll be very happy!

gloomy.li: They kept their word. Now I don't know what to do with all the disappointment I'd saved up.
[rain] Raining, naturally. But they kept their promise, so I'll let the rain off just this once.

cold.li: Promise honored, on time. Now I know which of them can be relied on and which of them only talk.
[skill:Social] Kept, as expected. I'd made sure they knew I was counting the days.

plain.li: So "{WISH}" came to nothing. I'd have taken a no.
[forother] It wasn't even for me. I asked on someone else's behalf, and they still couldn't be bothered.
[repeat] Same request, same silence. I could set the seasons by it.
[child] I asked the grown-ups and they forgot. I think grown-ups forget on purpose sometimes.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] Maybe I asked wrong. Too quiet, too loud, too often. I'll be up all night going over it.

warm.li: I'm not angry. I just wish someone had come by and said "not now". I'd have understood "not now".
[grieving] With everything that's happened lately, I can't blame them for forgetting. I only wish it hadn't been me they forgot.

blunt.li: They did nothing. Good to know where I stand. Somewhere behind the rice, apparently.
[doubtful] At this point I'd be more surprised if they'd actually done it.

cheerful.li: Didn't happen, so I'll sort it out myself. How, I haven't worked out!
[fall] Didn't get it. But the leaves are turning, and I refuse to be miserable in fall!

gloomy.li: Asked for "{WISH}" and heard nothing back. I'm used to that.
[lowmood] I'm not even upset. I'd have had to expect something first.

cold.li: No answer within a reasonable time. I'll treat that as their real answer and plan around them.
[rich] Full storerooms, and still they couldn't manage it. That was a choice.

plain.li: They promised me "{WISH}". Promised. I underlined the word so hard the page tore.
[trusting] I defended them when the others grumbled. I'll have to find something else to say now.
[night] Lying awake going over the conversation again. They said yes. I know they said yes.
[child] They promised. A promise is a promise. Even little kids know that.
[old] I've lived long enough to know promises break. Apparently not long enough to stop believing them.

warm.li: Something must have come up, I keep telling myself. I wish someone had come and told me what.
[skill:Social] I'll talk to them, calmly, tomorrow. Tonight I'm writing all the uncalm things down here, to get them out of me.

blunt.li: Promise broken. Next time they want me on the walls during a raid, I'll promise too.
No more benefit of the doubt. They had it and spent it.

cheerful.li: They broke it. I'm smiling, because the other choice is screaming into the fields.
[trait:Sanguine] Promise broken. I've decided to forgive them by breakfast. Possibly lunch.

gloomy.li: I let myself believe them. That's what I'm angriest about.
[winter] A broken promise and a cold bed. Winter's long enough without this.

cold.li: I extended them credit. They defaulted. That won't happen twice.
[skill:Intellectual] I've written down exactly who said what, and when. I don't trust my memory with it.

plain.li: Asked for "{WISH}". They said no and told me why. I hate that the reasons were good.
[repeat] Second no for the same thing. I'm starting to think it isn't the timing.
[forother] I asked for someone else and got a no. Now I have to go and tell them, which is worse.
[teen] They said no like I'm a little kid. I'm not a little kid. I'm writing this very calmly.
[child] They said no. I asked why. They said "because". Because isn't a reason. Everybody knows that.

warm.li: They said no gently, and one of them came by after to see if I was all right. That helped more than I'll admit.
[trusting] If they said no, there's a reason. I'll grumble first, then trust it.

blunt.li: A no. Fine. I'll remember that the next time they need someone to haul in the rain.
No. Of course. The easiest word they know.

cheerful.li: A real, honest, to-my-face no. Those are rare out here. I'm almost pleased!
[clear] They said no, but the sky was so clear tonight I couldn't stay sour for long!

gloomy.li: Turned down. It was a long shot, like everything out here.
[night] Lying in the dark rehearsing better ways I could have asked. None of them end in yes either.

cold.li: Refused, with reasons. Weak reasons, but reasons. I'll shape the next request so they can't use them.
[large] With this many mouths to please, they can't say yes to everyone. I simply assumed I'd be one of the exceptions.

plain.li: The council has gone with {DECREE}. I nodded through the whole announcement like it was my idea.
[trait:Industrious] So we're on {DECREE}. I could kiss whoever proposed it.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] They've declared {DECREE}. Less work for a while, if I play it right.
[bitter] The council declared {DECREE}, and for once I can't argue with them. I tried.
[child] The grown-ups made a new rule: {DECREE}. I like this one. I don't like most rules.

warm.li: I think {DECREE} will do us good. I'll keep an eye on the ones who are struggling with it.
[large] With so many of us, it helps to have everyone pulling the same way. I'm glad they chose {DECREE}.

blunt.li: Anyone who wants to whine about {DECREE} can whine to me.
One good decision. One. They're not off the hook.

cheerful.li: They declared {DECREE}, which is what I'd have done! I'm practically on the council.
[skill:Social] I've already talked three people round to {DECREE}!

gloomy.li: I agree with them about {DECREE}. Now I'm waiting to find out what it costs us.
[lowmood] I actually agreed with the council about {DECREE}. It felt strange.

cold.li: The decision to impose {DECREE} was overdue. I've already noted who argued against it.
[trusting] Another sound decision from the council. They're becoming predictable, which is useful.

plain.li: Declared: {DECREE}. I voted no in my head, very loudly.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] I'd planned a nap, and then they declared {DECREE}. I'm still having the nap, but I'll feel watched.
[trait:Wimp|trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] My hands haven't stopped shaking since they announced {DECREE}. The letters keep coming out crooked.
[trait:Gourmand] Ate two helpings at dinner over {DECREE}, and felt no better.
[summer,hot] Hot as a kiln, and now {DECREE} on top of it. Somebody up there has never sweated in their life.

warm.li: I'll do my part under {DECREE}. I just wish someone had asked how the rest of us were holding up first.
[grieving] I haven't the heart to fight {DECREE} right now. Ask me again when I've stopped crying at dinner.

blunt.li: They're welcome to try making me enjoy {DECREE}.
[bitter] Another thing done to us, not for us: {DECREE}.

cheerful.li: They declared {DECREE}. I'm being very positive about it, through my teeth!
Not even {DECREE} can ruin my week. It's having a good try, though!

gloomy.li: So it's {DECREE} now. I'm not going to say it can't get worse.
[rain] Rain all day, and the council declared {DECREE}. The sky and I are in agreement.

cold.li: The council declared {DECREE} without consulting anyone competent. I expect to be consulted after it fails.
[skill:Intellectual] I've worked out what {DECREE} will cost us. I'll present the figures when it fails.

plain.li: Year {YEARS}. I went and stood where I first walked in. It's a wall now.
[old] Year {YEARS} here, and more of my life behind me than ahead. I'd rather spend what's left with this lot.
[child] It's my anniversary here, number {YEARS}. That's a really big part of my life! I worked it out with pebbles.
[grieving] Anniversary. I tried to count the people who were here when I arrived. I stopped partway through.
[winter] Cold on my anniversary. Spent it chopping firewood, which is about how I spent my first day here.
[trait:Teetotaler] Someone offered me a drink for my anniversary. I had water and watched the rest of them get sillier.

warm.li: I wrote down the names of the people who made this year bearable. It took two pages.
[small] There are only a handful of us, and every one of them found me today to wish me well.

blunt.li: Year {YEARS}. Still standing.
[hurt] Another year. Held together with stitches and spite, but here.

cheerful.li: Anniversary number {YEARS}! I've cut a notch in the doorframe, one for every year.
[highmood] Anniversary, and a hot dinner, and I'm in a good mood. My first day here, I'd never have believed it!

gloomy.li: Year {YEARS} here. Longer than I've lasted anywhere. I don't trust it.
Somebody wished me a happy anniversary. I said thank you. I meant about half of it.

cold.li: I have now outlasted several colonists who were considered more valuable than me. Instructive.
[rich] The colony is worth far more now than when I arrived. A fair share of that is mine. I keep a list.

plain.li: Heard someone say "ask {TITLE}" in the next room. Took me a moment to realize they meant me.
[newcomer] I've barely been here long enough to learn everyone's names, and they've already given me one: {TITLE}.
[child] The grown-ups call me {TITLE} now. I practiced saying it in a deep voice.
[teen] Somebody called me {TITLE} at supper. I acted like I didn't care. I've written it on the inside of my boot.
[skill:Artistic] Spent the evening carving {TITLE} into a scrap of wood. Sanded it off. Carved it again.

warm.li: They call me {TITLE}, but I learned everything I know from people who aren't here to hear it.
The name {TITLE} has stuck, and they mean it kindly. I'd do a great deal for these people.

blunt.li: Being called {TITLE} doesn't come with extra rations. I checked.
[trait:Greedy] A new name, {TITLE}. Lovely. A bigger room would be lovelier.

cheerful.li: Three people called me {TITLE} at dinner! I nearly choked on my stew.
[skill:Social] I've been introducing myself as {TITLE} all day. People seem to like it!

gloomy.li: Now that I'm {TITLE}, they'll know exactly who to blame when it goes wrong.
[lowmood] I'm supposed to be {TITLE} now. I wish I felt like it.

cold.li: Being known as {TITLE} will make people defer to me. I intend to let them.
[large] In a colony this size, being {TITLE} gets me listened to. I'll use that.

plain.li: Someone yelled for {TITLE} across the yard and three people laughed. I laughed too, a bit late.
[child] They all call me {TITLE} now. I asked what it means and the grown-ups looked at each other.
[old] I had a perfectly good name for longer than most of them have been alive. Now I'm {TITLE}.
[hurt] I'd laugh about being called {TITLE}, but laughing hurts right now.
[trait:Ugly|trait:StaggeringlyUgly] They call me {TITLE}. It's kinder than what they said behind my back before.

warm.li: If somebody has to be {TITLE}, better me than someone who'd mind.
[small] With so few of us, everyone gets a nickname sooner or later. Mine is {TITLE}. I'm choosing to hear it as fondness.

blunt.li: Someone scratched {TITLE} into my bedframe. I know whose handwriting that is.
[trait:Brawler] People only call me {TITLE} from a safe distance, I notice.

cheerful.li: I'm {TITLE} now! Not the name I'd have picked, but it's catchy.
I've been {TITLE} since breakfast. Too good a day to mind!

gloomy.li: Of everything I've done here, {TITLE} is what stuck.
[lowmood] I can't even argue with being called {TITLE}. They're not wrong, and I'm tired.

cold.li: Being known as {TITLE} lowers what people expect of me. That can be useful.
[bitter] They chose {TITLE} for me. I've chosen names for each of them, in here, where they can't see.

plain.li: I've started looking at everything as if it's the last time, even the crooked shelf over my bed.
[winter] Leaving in winter. Stupid, I know. Staying would be stupider.
[fall] Leaving with the harvest half in. Someone else can bring in the rest.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] I can't tell if it's leaving that scares me, or staying.
[grieving] The people I stayed for are in the ground out back.

warm.li: I've said goodbye to the animals already. The people are harder. Some of them I'll actually miss.
[skill:Plants] Spent the evening in the fields. Somebody had better look after them properly when I'm gone.

blunt.li: Three days. If they want me to stay, they know what to say. They won't say it.
[trait:Greedy] I'm taking my share. I earned it. Every last scrap.

cheerful.li: Leaving will be an adventure. I said it out loud six times today, and it nearly works!
[spring] At least I'm leaving in spring, with flowers out along the road!

gloomy.li: Told them I'm going. I'm waiting to see if anyone asks me to stay.
[rain] Raining on my last days here, of course.

cold.li: I've worked out what I can carry and what I'm owed. The difference will be settled before I go.
[large] They won't miss one person in a colony this size. That was the problem all along.

plain.li: Spent the evening sweeping up splinters and setting the table back on its legs.
[hurt] New scar. I'm told I was lucky. I saw what unlucky looked like today, so I believe it.
[winter,snow] Blood on snow is the brightest red there is. I'd rather not know that.
[fog] Fog so thick we heard them before we saw them. I can still hear them.
[child] There was fighting and the grown-ups told me to hide and I hid. I was very good at hiding. I don't want to be good at it.
[teen] First real fight where they let me help. I thought I'd feel brave. Mostly I felt sick.

warm.li: Sat with the hurt ones until they fell asleep. I'm good at holding a hand.
[skill:Medicine] Stitched until my fingers cramped. Everyone I worked on is still breathing. Writing that down first, before anything else.

blunt.li: They came for our stuff. Most of them are our stuff now.
[trait:Bloodlust] Good day. Don't tell the others I said that.

cheerful.li: We're alive! I hugged three people who didn't want to be hugged, and one of them hugged back.
[highmood] Good fight! The people I love are all in one piece, and somebody left a really nice hat behind.

gloomy.li: Washed someone else's blood out of my shirt tonight. It never fully comes out.
[lowmood] During the fight I caught myself thinking: if I go now, at least I won't have to clean up after.

cold.li: Everything that falls out there is meat, leather or spare parts. We waste too much of it.
[skill:Shooting] I watched how each of them behaved under fire. I know now who I want beside me, and who I want in front.

plain.li: Called {OTHER_nameDef} in for supper before I remembered.
[night] Woke up and listened for {OTHER_nameDef}. Old habit. It'll take a while to break.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} isn't coming back. The grown-ups keep saying it in soft voices, like I didn't hear the first time.
[old] I've written too many of these. {OTHER_nameDef} goes under the others, and the page is nearly full.
[afterraid] They came, and {OTHER_nameDef} didn't walk away from it. I keep going over where I was standing.

warm.li: I kept something of {OTHER_nameDef}'s. I won't say what. It's under my pillow and it's staying there.
[spring] Everything's coming up green. {OTHER_nameDef} won't see it, so I'll look twice.

blunt.li: The work still needed doing, {OTHER_nameDef} or no. So I did it.
[bitter] {OTHER_nameDef} is dead, and tomorrow the council will argue about chores like nothing happened.

cheerful.li: I told a story about {OTHER_nameDef} at dinner and the others laughed. Then I went outside for a while by myself.
[rain] {OTHER_nameDef} always liked the rain. I've left the shutters open tonight.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} will need a grave. We've got too good at digging them.
[lowmood,afterraid] It should have been me. I don't mean that dramatically. I was standing closer.

cold.li: Worked out who takes over {OTHER_nameDef}'s chores. Then sat in the empty room longer than was necessary.
[trait:Psychopath] I'm told I should feel something about {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm writing this to find out if I do. Inconclusive.
